description: Phase 10 variant of the Phase 9 ledger harness: the same original payment functions plus four that recover from a failed COMMIT inside the process that saw the failure; one process per actor execution, through the CommitRift fault proxy when a connection is to be broken.

recordPaymentIdempotent.description: UNIQUE(request_id) with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, then confirm.

recordPaymentReconciled.description: Look for the request first, record only when absent.

settleOrder.description: Two autocommit writes: ledger row (idempotent), then the order status.

settleWithAudit.description: Transaction; the audit row is written through the pool.

recordPaymentRetryInProcess.description: Blind: retry the whole transaction once after any error.

recordPaymentIdempotentRetryInProcess.description: UNIQUE(request_id) with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; retry once after any error.

recordPaymentReconciledRetryInProcess.description: After an error look for the request first, record only when absent.

recordPaymentAutocommitRetryInProcess.description: Blind autocommit insert, retried once after any error.
